title: Create your developer profile
intro: Four quick steps. No email and no password: your profile is saved on this device.

name.label: What should we call you?
name.hint: Your display name. Nicknames are fine; never your email.

seniority.label: What's your seniority?
seniority.hint: Declare it as it is: you compete against comparable profiles.

stack.label: What's your stack?
stack.hint: Choose 1 to {max} technologies you work with.
stack.noResults: No technology in this role's categories matches “{query}”.
stack.limit: You've reached the limit of {max} technologies.

review.label: Ready to compete?
review.privacy: Your profile is private. Nothing is public until you choose it.

networkError: We couldn't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.

competing.title: Competing as
competing.savedOnDevice: Your progress is saved on this device.
competing.nextBody: Play Ranked and Practice arrive in the next update. Your profile is ready for them.
